SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF OCT-27-2016 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF OCT-27-2016 BY DONALD S. MITCHELL. APPEARANCE BY PLAINTIFF WINNIE YAN. APPEARANCE BY DEFENDANT MIAO HU WITH ASSISTANCE FROM COURT CERTIFIED CANTONESE INTERPRETER RICHARD SHEK. DEFENDANT TO MAKE MONTHLY PAYMENTS OF $400.00 DEPOSITED INTO BANK ACCOUNT # PROVIDED BY PLAINTIFF. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: DONALD S. MITCHELL. CLERK: S. LE. NOT REPORTED. (506)
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF OCT-27-2016 - JUDGMENT. JUDGE: DONALD S. MITCHELL. CLERK: S. LE. NOT REPORTED. (506)

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF YAN, WINNIE RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT HU, MIAO $10,000.00 PRINCIPAL, $115.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $10,115.00, PAYMENTS ARE TO BE MADE AT THE RATE OF $400.00 PER MONTH, BEGINNING ON NOVEMBER 27, 2016 AND ON THE 27TH DAY OF EACH MONTH THEREAFTER UNTIL PAID IN FULL. IF ANY PAYMENT IS MISSED, THE ENTIRE BALANCE BECOMES DUE IMMEDIATELY. (SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT) STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS NO EXHIBITS FILED
COST BILL AFTER JUDGMENT, $3,200.00 CREDIT ACKNOWLEDGED, $1,125.12 ACCRUED INTEREST AS TO PLAINTIFF YAN, WINNIE

CLAIM OF EXEMPTION PACKET-COVER SHEET RECEIVED FROM SHERIFF'S DEPARTMENT FOR 01/11/2018 HEARING.
STIPULATION FOR HEARING BEFORE PRO TEM COMMISSIONER FILED BY YAN, WINNIE HU, MIAO

THE CLAIM OF EXEMPTION SET FOR JAN-11-2018 IS DENIED. THE JUDGMENT DEBTOR'S CLAIM OF EXEMPTION IS DENIED. THE LEVYING OFFICER IS DIRECTED TO RELEASE ANY EARNINGS HELD TO THE JUDGMENT CREDITOR FOR PAYMENT ON THE JUDGMENT PER JUDGE PRO TEM MARC SEIDENFELD. JUDGMENT CREDITOR WINNIE YAN APPEARED. JUDGMENT DEBTOR MIAO HU APPEARED. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE PRO TEM: MARC SEIDENFELD; CLERK: J. BERTELSEN; NOT REPORTED. (506)
